name: NASA GFSAD30 Global Cropland Extent 2015 Validation Dataset (GFSAD30VAL)
description: NASA GFSAD30VAL is an independent, global ground-truth validation dataset produced by the Global Food Security-support Analysis Data (GFSAD) project led by the USGS and NASA LP DAAC. Comprising 18,986 rigorously vetted reference sample points distributed across agro-ecological zones on all global continents, the dataset provides ground-truth assessments separating cropland and non-cropland areas to evaluate and benchmark global 30-meter cropland extent satellite products.
